description: The Croatian Bureau of Statistics publishes the housing results of the 2021 Census of Population, Households and Dwellings as bilingual Excel workbooks for the whole country, for counties and for every town and municipality. The municipal workbook has four tables: dwellings by occupancy status with surface area, housing units by number of households and members, occupied dwellings by rooms and ownership, and occupied dwellings and their residents by auxiliary rooms, installations and air conditioning. The installations counted are water supply, a sewage disposal system, electricity and gas. Coverage is the whole country: of 2,391,944 dwellings, 1,433,445 were occupied for permanent residence; of those, 1,431,509 had water supply, 1,422,395 sewage disposal, 1,431,981 electricity and 591,888 gas. The same census page offers population, household and settlement workbooks. Format and access: free XLSX downloads, no registration. Licence: no licence named; users are asked to state the source. Caveats: municipal level only for these housing tables, with no settlement or grid breakdown; the sewage column is labelled sewage disposal system without separating public sewers. Simulation uses: municipal gas and sewage coverage for network planning, empty and occasional dwellings for tourism and seasonal demand, and dwelling stock for exposure. Related records: the Georgia 2024 census dwelling facilities tables and EUBUCCO building footprints.
